constraints: The words the record uses. The standard does not classify or infer a type.
fields.label: Diabetes type as written in the record

constraints: Often only a year is known. An estimate must stay visible as an estimate.
fields.label: Date diabetes was recorded as diagnosed

constraints: The value and its unit travel together. No conversion is done here and no value is judged.
fields.label: HbA1c result value

constraints: The collection time, not the time the result was filed.
fields.label: When the HbA1c sample was collected

constraints: The value and its unit travel together. No conversion is done here and no value is judged.
fields.label: Glucose result value

constraints: The collection time, not the time the result was filed.
fields.label: When the glucose sample was collected

constraints: One recorded status per result: fasting, not fasting, or not recorded. It is never inferred from the time of day.
fields.label: Fasting status of the glucose sample as recorded

constraints: Only that a plan exists in the record. What the plan says is never carried.
fields.label: Whether a treatment plan is written down

exclusions: Diagnosis, classification, targets and treatment choice.
Any drug, dose or amount of anything given.
intent.population: People recorded as having diabetes. No narrower scope is assumed.
intent.purpose: Record what was documented about diabetes and glycaemia tests, and when, so that documentation can be described for local review.
intent.rationale: Documentation and timing questions can be asked without any clinical number, so the second demonstration needs no threshold.
intent.setting: Any care setting that follows people with diabetes. Narrowing is for the local clinician to declare.

provenance.basis: None. No clinical source and no clinical review.
provenance.origin: Synthetic demonstration written for the second demo (row 4.5a).
